notes: Labeled "Sonnet 5.6 (next)" by the repo owner, who believes requests for claude-sonnet-5-5 were being routed to a newer model at the time. Before the prompt, the same session answered one short no-tools question the repo owner uses to check which model is answering. The prompt was written by an orchestrating Claude Opus 5.5 session that only prompted; all code is the Sonnet session's own. It was sent with the output folder filled in, an opening line saying the check had passed, and one line naming the OS, ffmpeg and the Edge install path. prompt.md leaves those out. The session also got three follow-up messages. The first resumed the build after the repo owner stopped it by accident for about 2 minutes, and added three review notes from the orchestrator: log ends poking out of canopies, flat birch bark and stair-stepped distant cliffs. The other two resumed it after provider connection errors, which left it idle for about 33 minutes in total. Build time includes those gaps. Another program shared the GPU for part of the run.
